notes.title: 🌾 Update 0.9.8 – Fresh Tools, New Systems, Bigger Dreams
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Features [/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][i]The game world changed totally. It's now 10x bigger.[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/61d8a079dc0d2e8ad2e05f7eaefb177788357de4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Added water tower and sprinkler.[/i][/h3][p]To use the sprinkler you need to build the water tower so you can water your plants very quickly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/abdf17c063ea631fbf38bacbbc0816f3d243a207.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Added various seafood with the fishing boat.[/i][/h3][p]You can repair the fishing boat and get the ingredients you need for meals![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/962c29f759cdfc0c792ea4249b54da5bcce8a16d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Coffee machine and coffees added.[/i][/h3][p]Drinking coffee is a great way to recharge your depleting energy! It is not recommended to waste it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/ec01d63b147d7053f0dfb893a7df3ff3f7883540.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Hire your stuff[/i][/h3][p]The Cook and waiters have been added. So you can make and serve your meals faster. Train them to be better![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/dddeb4c35bbf1723b5f5fb19f03a3a6611d25663.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][i]Farming is more live now![/i][/h3][p]Cows, chickens, pigs and sheep are ready to come to your farm![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/8b90c6f73bdcfd0d3cc6e4d5a3528e9cb6f5c4f8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Faster Harvesting![/i][/h3][p]Added new basket for faster harvesting. No more wasting time for harvest! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/528a5790d772ec04003ba62fa949811ab7b61027.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Restaurant decoration section opened.[/i][/h3][p]Added carpenter allows you to build your new furniture.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/35463eed4f1dd5a28c8e8996e7dec920c48a73cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Added a new video for sleep scene.[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/fa5d40eae4521ca1b72e0d53bd9fefb016670cad.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][i]The handbook is now available for quick information![/i][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/7d1ec0f172adefc8ea9a2da9fe09c344cd66aa5d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Added “Save Me” to the main menu. We hope that you don't need it :)[/i][/h3][p]
[/p][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][h3]Customer models have been re-modeled and optimized.[/h3][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/b34deb88be83af52b181183f64a8ad1016e940dd.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2][b]Minor Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]UI screens have been updated. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated in-game icons. [/p][/*][*][p]Fast travel has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated item crafting times. [/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p]
[/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed horse movement problems. [/p][/*][*][p]Widget bugs fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]Translation bugs fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Patch 0.4.9.7 - Character Customization Is Just Arrived!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Harvest Cafe farmers![/b]

We are happy to annoıunce our new character creation module.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/70b83a9b0a0c2d4f0f19df3616ce1834a67ce114.gif[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now we can customize our character as we wish and turn it into a new character.
[*] Four new voice selection features have been added to our characterAdded sound to plant watering.
[*] Added widget that shows what happens when we hover over items
[*] We now have the ability to destroy the structures we create if we want.
[*] We now have a new feature that allows us to receive notifications when it is time to sleep without fainting.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/c1715337a955b54e50c4e5b6cae917e668f34c2e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update Patch 0.4.9
notes.notes:
[h2]New Sound Effects[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sound to play when the player picks up something from the ground
[*] Added coin sound to play when the player picks up the coin from the table
[*] A coin sound has been added to the game when the player buys or sells a new product from the market.
[*] It was added to the game that when the player opens the panels in the market, a random one of 4 different “Hello Farmer” voices is played depending on the gender of the NPC.
[*] Added a special sound to play when the player opens the restaurant.
[*] Added a wooden box opening sound to play when the Storage Box is opened.
[*] Added wind-blowing sound to the paper when opening the map panel.
[*] Added a sound to play when the refrigerator is turned on.
[*] Added a sizzling sound to play while cooking.
[*] The feature of playing tool sounds while crafting in the Workbench has been added to the game.
[*] Added sound playback when opening the inventory.
[*] All sounds were connected to the SFX channel and the ability to be dimmed from the menu was introduced.
[*] Added sound playback when flowers are watered.
[*] Added sound play feature when water is filled from the well.
[*] Added sound playback feature while harvesting plants.
[*] Added the ability to play sound when we put and remove items from crafting structures, storage, and refrigerator.
[*] Added the feature of playing sound when we take the plate from the counter and give the plate to the customer.
[*] Added the sound of cicadas in the evening and the sound of the forest during the day.
[*] A feature has been added to the game where the clock plays a ticking sound when the time is advanced, that is if someone faints while sleeping at night and the restaurant opens early.
[*] Added the feature of playing crowded ambient sound when we are inside the restaurant and there are customers.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/a4d778c673064e7bfc157cc4738e60515fc7c921.png[/img]
*About This Image : Customer Rigging Fix

[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
[list]
[*] Customers restaurant routes have been improved
[*] Gathering resources made easier
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/f56f32cda62081000cdf112cec7490c2bf1bc863.png[/img]
*About This Image : Player Idle and Running animations are improved.

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Object details are now displayed separately on all inventory screens.
[*] Player notification added to structures that have finished production
[*] Fixed the animations and skeletal structures of the customers.
[*] Customers now act according to the food they eat. They play separate food animations like Soup or Sushi.
[*] Player Idle and Running animations are improved.
[/list]


[url=https://discord.gg/2cYzTPZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: It's Time For The First Patch!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Farmers!

We have some new features and improvements. Here are some of them.[/b]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New food models have been added.
[*] GamePad support has been added.
[*] New languages have been added (French, Italian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, Bulgarian, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Romanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek, Czech, Swedish).
[*] New sound effects have been added.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/ff388fd280a61416272485db4910fe108985150f.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The process of adding agricultural land has been simplified.
[*] Food service to customers has been improved.
[*] The spawn algorithm has been improved.
[*] The customer behavior system has been improved.
[*] Farm structures have been made easier to use.
[*] The trade balance has been improved.
[*] In-game visual improvements have been made.
[*] Adjustments have been made to player controls.
[*] The issue with the growth cycle of plants has been improved. Plants no longer spoil if not harvested at full maturity.
[*] User interface improvements have been made. 
[*] Restaurant improvements have been made.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949607/c88abcb442d9064e9206e0f15769d75c56cc6fdc.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] The character's energy problems have been solved.
[*] Animation bugs have been fixed.
[*] The saving bug has been fixed.
[*] Bugs in the existing shopping list in shops have been fixed.
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy the game and thank you so much for your patience and support!

[url=https://discord.gg/2cYzTPZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png[/img][/url]
